about: Christopher T. Hurley is an attorney who represents clients in the Chicago, Illinois area. Christopher Hurley is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Christopher Hurley chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Loyola University Chicago School of Law and graduated in 1984. Christopher Hurley passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1984.

He represents clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues in Illinois. He also represents clients with Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Plaintiff and Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Christopher Hurley has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
